# HeyGen Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill for HeyGen's AI video platform: generate one-shot prompt-to-video clips, build multi-scene avatar videos from a script, list avatars and voices, and poll render status. Honest note: API usage is separately metered and billed from plan credits — every generation costs real money, and custom avatars cost $99 one-time. The skill confirms with you before every generation and never generates from a face upload unless you explicitly provide the video yourself.
